name: Cyclone Metals Limited
summary: Cyclone Metals Limited and its associated entities invest in, discover and evaluate mineral assets, targeting cobalt, lithium, iron ore, copper, uranium, gold and lead-silver-zinc. Its portfolio includes the Marampa project in West Africa, made up of a mining license of 97.40 square kilometers and an exploration license of 145.86 square kilometers, and the Kukuna project.
